Unaware that his entire existence is a meticulously orchestrated 24/7 reality television show broadcasted globally, an ordinary insurance salesman begins to notice bizarre anomalies in his hometown. As the cracks in his artificial reality widen, he must muster the courage to confront his unseen director and risk everything for the terrifying truth of the outside world. This darkly comedic tale explores the ultimate existential dilemma of a man fighting to reclaim his stolen free will from the ratings-obsessed creators who made him a global icon.
